extraction_notes.note: The paper has no theorem environments: all results are stated in running text and reached by order-by-order calculation through 75 numbered eqnarray equations. Intermediate derived equations (e.g. $m_{(1)}=0$, $\gamma_{(1)}=0$) are kept as equation nodes linked by uses edges rather than promoted to claims.

The restatement in Section 3.3 that the metric of a solution is Einstein (see Herfray et al.) repeats the claim of Section 3.1 and gets no node; the Introduction's motivational previews of later results and the summarising Discussion are likewise not extracted.
Definition or claim: the sentence both asserts that conformally compact Einstein metrics are asymptotically hyperbolic and names them Poincare--Einstein metrics; kept as the definition.
One sentence both gives the divergent expansion of $V_\epsilon$ and defines the renormalised volume (7); kept as one definition node because the sentence cannot be split.
The sentence defining the momentum (28) and stating the 3+1 field equations (29) is a claim (proved in Appendix B by the Hamiltonian analysis) rather than a definition.
